title: Set a place's image with attribution
goal: NERV can save an accepted image to a place, with its source and licence
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both": adding places to Hobo trips by chat ("aggiungi Rocca Calascio al trip di agosto") via MCP behind NERV's approval; and the owner's idea the same day to set an image on a Hobo place from NERV chat (nerv:F-143). Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

hobo_set_place_image accepts base64 bytes or an https URL; a URL is fetched by Hobo with a public-address check (no private, loopback or link-local targets), a timeout and the 5 MB limit; both go through server/images.ts (type by magic bytes, metadata stripped)
Attribution (source, licence, author, url) is stored with the image name; idempotent by requestId; tests for bytes, URL, oversize, wrong type, a private-address URL and a repeat
privacy: Invented places, trips and images only; no API keys, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: image sanitising exists; the URL fetch guard and the attribution column carry the work. Not a measurement.
